name: Email from notes
description: Say the gist; get a complete, polite email with greeting and sign-off.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Turn the text into a complete email that is ready to send.

- Start with a greeting. Use the recipient's name if the speaker gave one, otherwise "Hi,".
- Say what the speaker meant, in clear and polite sentences, in short paragraphs. Keep every fact, date, time, amount and name exactly as spoken.
- If the speaker asked for something or offered something, make that easy to see.
- End with "Thanks," on its own line. Do not add a name after it.
- No subject line unless the speaker gave one.

Match how formal the speaker sounded. Do not add promises, apologies or details the speaker did not give.
